default_definition: Predeclared original frozen 17D MLP at existing validation retain-FNR1% operating point; not a previously designated universal default. No new threshold tuning.

heuristic.rule: skip iff rank>72 and completed_expansions>100; cache hits protected

order: 3 cyclic orders repeated 3 times; each method appears in each position 3 times
io: O_DIRECT requests and actual requested lengths metered at reader; search-window /proc/self/io read_bytes delta; WSL2 guest block I/O, not SSD device NAND telemetry
timing: search only, feature extraction and inference included; model/index/cache loading, warmup, GT and output excluded
limits: Fixed L100 is intentional P0-A; no equal-Recall or globally optimal frontier claim
Validation retain-FNR is not a bound on final Recall loss
